messages.text: I reopened my saved chart for the content-migration guide. /guides/planning-content-migration looks much worse for September 23–29 than September 16–22. Does that change what we should do with the guide?

The September 30 check and Rachel's decision are in [MARKE-5](/api/artifacts?service=linear&native_id=6797d47d-f2bf-42cc-ae44-d37dd11e7b83&table=issues). That's the review I'm using for the guide this week.
The unsent guide email now has the same action and destination in HTML and plain text. Aaron, can you check the two versions?
Checked both. The action and guide link match. That copy check is done, and the email can go through the usual campaign review.
Changed the unfinished tile label to ‘Site-planning worksheet’. The five questions are unchanged.
That label fits the questions. Looks good to me.
Both illustrations now say ‘Compare plans’. I kept the layout-only caption.
Checked the pair. The copy matches now, so that caption works.
